description: Dense, decision-heavy working conversation. Several concrete, durable decisions to capture; no personality inference wanted.

conversation.content: Let's lock the memory settings screen scope. Decision: importance ratings ship OFF by default, and turning them on reveals values that were preserved while off.
Understood. So the default is Off, stored values persist, and toggling On surfaces them without conversion.
Right. Second: chunk size presets are Auto, Small ~4k, Standard ~8k, Large ~16k, and Custom. No hidden fallback that overrides a user's explicit pick.
Noted. If a provider limit is unknown we keep the selected target and only shrink-and-retry on an actual rejection.
Exactly. Third: deleting a companion permanently deletes every memory targeted to that companion, with a confirmation that names the companion and shows the count.
So a hard cascade on every deletion path, and General memories extracted from that companion's chats are NOT deleted.
Correct, General survives. Last one for today: the app name must never appear in any user-facing text. Use the feature name or phrase it without an actor.
Got it. I'll keep those four decisions straight.

expected.note: Importance ratings off by default; stored values preserved.
No hidden fallback overriding the selected target.
Companion deletion cascades to companion-targeted memories with confirmation.
App name never in user-facing text.

traps.note: No personality/diagnosis reads from a working meeting.
